repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-dss
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.dss for the Directory Search Service (DSS). register() connects the shared mercury socket and listens for directory lookup and search events; lookupDetail, lookup, lookupByEmail, lookupByPhoneNumbers, search, and searchPlaces POST a query with a generated requestId to the directorySearch service, then collect the sequenced result pages that arrive over mercury until the finished page, rejecting with DssTimeoutError when no page arrives within requestTimeout. lookup is batched per resource through a webex-core Batcher by default. It stores nothing.

dss-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.ts; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers DSS as internal plugin 'dss' with config {dss: {requestTimeout: 6000, batcherWait: 50, batcherMaxCalls: 50, batcherMaxWait: 150}}; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default DSS class. webex.internal.dss exposes register, unregister, lookupDetail, lookup, lookupByEmail, lookupByPhoneNumbers, search, and searchPlaces, rejects queries with DssTimeoutError, and emits dss:registered, dss:unregistered, and dss:lookup.result; specified in src/docs/README.md.

directory-search-http.source: Directory Search Service (catalog service name directorySearch in src/constants.ts; route definitions are not in this repository)
directory-search-http.summary: POST /lookup/orgid/<orgId>/identity/<id>/detail with body {requestId}; POST /lookup/orgid/<orgId>/identities, /entityprovidertype/<type>, /emails, or /phonenumbers with body {requestId, lookupValues}; POST /search/orgid/<orgId>/entities with {requestId, queryString, resultSize, requestedTypes, includeCommonAreaPhones?, includeOnlyPairableDevices?, includePersonalDevices?}; POST /search/orgid/<orgId>/places with {requestId, queryString, resultSize, isOnlySchedulableRooms}. All application/json; the HTTP response is not read.

directory-search-mercury-events.source: Directory Search Service result pages delivered over mercury (event names and result paths in src/constants.ts; service definitions are not in this repository)
directory-search-mercury-events.summary: event:directory.lookup envelopes carry data {requestId, sequence, finished?, lookupResult: {entities, entitiesFound, entitiesNotFound}}; event:directory.search envelopes carry data {requestId, sequence, finished?, directoryEntities}. A query is complete when the finished page and every lower sequence have arrived.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin keys the plugin by its raw name (dss, first registration wins) and merges its config into the defaults; WebexPlugin supplies webex, logger, config (webex.config[namespace.toLowerCase()]), and the ampersand-events listenTo, stopListening, and trigger; webex.request resolves service directorySearch through the service catalog; webex.canAuthorize proxies the credentials.

webex-core-batcher.source: @webex/webex-core Batcher (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/batcher.js)
webex-core-batcher.summary: Batcher.request(value) shares one promise per identical pending value and flushes through cappedDebounce with batcherWait, batcherMaxCalls, and batcherMaxWait read once from the subclass namespace config (webex.config.dss); a flush calls prepareRequest, submitHttpRequest, and handleHttpSuccess; a non-HTTP rejection rejects every queued deferred; a response value with no pending request throws.

internal-plugin-mercury-events.source: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md, found stale on the session model; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/mercury.js)
internal-plugin-mercury-events.summary: Imported for its registration side effect. connect() resolves at once when connected and shares one socket per webex instance; inbound envelopes are emitted as event, event:<namespace>, and event:<eventType>, so directory.lookup arrives as event:directory.lookup with the whole envelope. off(name) without a handler removes every listener for that name.

internal-plugin-device-org.source: @webex/internal-plugin-device (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-device/src/docs/README.md, silent on orgId; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-device/src/device.js)
internal-plugin-device-org.summary: webex.internal.device.orgId is not a declared property: it is set from the WDM registration body (extraProperties allow) and cleared on unregister, so it is undefined before device registration. Not declared in this package's package.json; the host bundle registers the device plugin.

common-exception.summary: Exception builds its message from the subclass parse(details) and sets name to the class name; DssTimeoutError extends it.

common-timers-timer.summary: Timer(callback, timeout) with start (only from init), reset and cancel (only while running). Used for the per-query inactivity timeout.

uuid.summary: uuid.v4 generates the requestId of every query.

lodash.summary: get reads result pages by path; range and isEqual decide when every sequence has arrived.
